observations.title: Garden grass mound
observations.observed_weakness: A broad uniform green mound with hard rim/highlight has little authored material detail.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Painted sun, seed, butterflies and Roshan carry shaped light, material cues and authored contours. Green palette already belongs to the scene.
observations.proposed_update: Inventory existing calm painted grass/ground first. Reuse a cohesive whole ground strip or commission only the missing grassy base, preserving open negative space around five plants.
observations.must_preserve: Five slots and their unobstructed input envelopes; no added distracting props.
observations.limits: New named-role registry binding required; not yet a new counted unique design.

observations.title: Five Garden clay pots
observations.observed_weakness: Five repeated flat rounded terracotta shapes with a generic white highlight do not clearly describe an open soil-filled pot.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Brown painted seeds have texture and shaded volume. The plants must root at the same soil line as these containers.
observations.proposed_update: Use one authored clay-pot design repeated five times, with a readable shallow opening/soil and restrained contact shadow. Inventory reusable containers before generation.
observations.must_preserve: 150x100 visible envelope and slot spacing; soil/contact line at 615; preserve seed < sprout < flower hierarchy.
observations.limits: Five instances of one family, not five independently generated designs. Recheck all growth states and occlusion.

observations.title: Common Garden sprout
observations.classification: Shaded raster style candidate; not automatically vector
observations.observed_weakness: Geometric rod stem and simple elliptical leaves have a simpler surface treatment than Roshan and the sun.
observations.same_scene_comparison: All five plants share this sprout and the same brown seed/pot family. Existing painted flower/leaf cards offer more authored contours but are not exact sprout replacements.
observations.proposed_update: Reuse a suitable complete seedling if found; otherwise draw one common sprout matching the scene’s gentle indigo contours, green family and soil entry. Do not randomly rebuild each sprout.
observations.must_preserve: One shared identity, 148x148 art rect, 0.881 stem-bottom mapping, approximately 105px visible height; root at soil.
observations.limits: The art35 alternate is byte-identical; a detached broad leaf is not an accepted whole sprout.

observations.observed_weakness: Simple shaded petal/leaf forms and rod stems feel less authored than the adjacent painted world cards.

observations.proposed_update: Audit whole-card reuse for this specific flower first. Where reuse fails, redraw the named outcome with compatible contours, soft painted surfaces and the same distinct blossom structure; review all five together before integration.
observations.must_preserve: Current slot/order, distinct five outcomes, 228x228 art rect, approximately 170px visible height, stable soil entry, 0.12s 1.2 pop then 0.12s settle.
observations.limits: No blanket finding that all raster flowers are flat vector; art35 alternate is byte-identical; identity/fit/phone acceptance still open.

observations.title: Garden watering can
observations.observed_weakness: The small pink can has a rougher contour/resolution than Roshan and floats nearby as a watching/watering cue.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Existing sun and seed have finer painted shaping. Palette already matches the pink/purple family.
observations.proposed_update: Preserve this can’s identity; check its best source master and non-destructive cleanup before requesting new pixels. Review readable spout orientation and intentional relation to Roshan/flowers.
observations.must_preserve: 272x286 transparent raster; runtime 130x137 rect and 0.32 rotation; do not claim or fake a hand-held contact. Protected book art remains untouched.
observations.limits: Alpha exterior is transparent; no white-background contamination defect was found.

observations.title: Picture-game gradient fields
observations.classification: Confirmed generated flat field; material/context candidate
observations.observed_weakness: Large smooth gradients supply calm negative space but no authored scene material.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Garden uses warm painted props; Snowman needs snow; Trampoline uses Roshan/star; Xmas has a detailed cool tree/ornaments. Each needs its own environmental/paper context.
observations.proposed_update: Inventory calm existing backgrounds per game. Reuse or draw a context-specific painted field with restrained depth, keeping targets clear; do not put a random busy landscape behind every activity.
observations.must_preserve: HUD and all input envelopes; native background coverage/import/overdraw rules; source-specific scene identity.
observations.limits: Per-game callers require separate resolution; this is not coverage of Slide or every aspect/state.

observations.title: Picture growth/win sparkle polygons
observations.observed_weakness: Growth and win bursts are flat eight-point stars.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Nearby butterflies/sun and the large Trampoline star are authored raster art; a simple painted sparkle may fit without imitating the large objective star.
observations.proposed_update: Inspect reusable painted sparkles and share a small authored family; preserve palette and effect limits. Review the burst at full speed, settles and close/reentry.
observations.must_preserve: Action max three concurrent bursts; win replaces old bursts; 4..18 elements; 0.35..0.9s lifetime; existing one-owner feedback layer.
observations.limits: Stills do not validate complete motion/seams/phone overdraw.

observations.title: Snowman snow field
observations.observed_weakness: Huge flattened/translucent rounded panels create grey bands and a large white highlight rather than a snowy ground surface.
observations.same_scene_comparison: The smaller rolling ball has the same generic style; future carrot/coal and action need a coherent snow family.
observations.proposed_update: Reuse a quiet painted snow ground if suitable; otherwise supply one snowy base with local snow grain and gentle cool shadows, preserving the rolling workspace.
observations.must_preserve: Rolling gestures, CTA/hint, stacking area and phase behavior.
observations.limits: Ready stage only; no face/stack/chase source comparison accepted here.

observations.title: Snowball rolling/stacked family
observations.observed_weakness: The ready ball is a generic flat white disc with border/shadow; growth and stacking need one coherent snow material.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Snow field currently shares generic panel treatment. Later face props are separate approved candidates, not substitutes for the child’s rolling action.
observations.proposed_update: Inspect existing complete snowball assets, otherwise draw one reusable snowball family compatible with snowy field; preserve dynamic size and contact.
observations.must_preserve: Start radius26; final radii124/98/72; circles accumulate3/2.5/2 turns; grow/stack/face/chase states and no automatic zero-input win.
observations.limits: Growing/stacked family is source-bound only in this slice; full interaction capture remains required.

observations.title: Trampoline mat/frame and detached highlight
observations.observed_weakness: Flat blue capsule lacks readable mat/frame material. Its large white child highlight hangs below the pad after the parent height is reduced to56.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Roshan and the objective star already have authored contours/lighting. Their palette can guide the mat without redrawing them.
observations.proposed_update: Inventory complete trampoline art; replace the capsule/highlight with one context-matched painted mat/frame with readable spring surface/support. Align Roshan’s intended rest/landing relationship and review each bounce.
observations.must_preserve: 400x140 touch target at440,430; visible mat envelope440,492/400x56; current bounce input/rhythm, Roshan identity and large star objective.
observations.limits: Rest/ready observations only. Star overlaps instruction panel in both aspects; solve spacing within existing objective behavior, not by deleting the target.

observations.title: Xmas ornament card material
observations.classification: Confirmed visible flat frame; whole caller remains open
observations.observed_weakness: Uniform white rounded cards and dark rims are materially plainer than the detailed tree and ornaments.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Five ornaments share polished jewel/shell forms; the sixth flower is protected source artwork and disabled initially.
observations.proposed_update: Reuse one compatible painted card material across the five active ornaments and locked flower state while preserving distinct feedback states. Retain the existing undecorated tree and detachable components.
observations.must_preserve: 110x110 ornament cards, protected friendship flower, disabled/enabled distinction, precise placement/one-finger input.
observations.limits: No predecorated replacement tree; ready stills do not close placement/topper/payoff states.

observations.title: Picture header and shell crest
observations.classification: Visible flat UI ornament/material; caller classification open
observations.observed_weakness: Pale rounded panel and line-only fan crest are plainer than the authored picture props. At1280 the fixed Back disc covers the crest; expanded width separates them.
observations.same_scene_comparison: All four picture games share the same header language and approved indigo palette.
observations.proposed_update: Audit a reusable painted paper/shell-header family and distinct Back presentation; test safe-area spacing at both aspects with exact actionable content and voice cues.
observations.must_preserve: Readable touch/navigation semantics, accessible contrast, current text/voice goals and non-overlapping input.
observations.limits: Do not exempt all StyleBoxFlat callers as functional or redesign lesson content.

observations.title: Garden medal card and starburst
observations.observed_weakness: The cream tier card, bronze medal glyph, star row and radial flat stars use a different material treatment from nearby painted flowers.
observations.same_scene_comparison: Reward hierarchy should remain clearly distinguishable from plant-growth feedback and the large Trampoline objective star.
observations.proposed_update: Inventory existing painted medal/sparkle assets; preserve tier distinctions, a single bounded celebration owner and reward timing. Review the exact0..2.2s lifecycle and reentry.
observations.must_preserve: CELEBRATION_SECONDS=2.2; one Canvas celebration; bronze/silver/gold/perfect states and safe input.
observations.limits: Immediate reentry after0.7s can legitimately show this still-live medal. No stale indefinite-overlay defect asserted. Bind medal source roles before adding new unique-design counts.
